clare: auditor (KPMG) looking for evidence of the emergency KMS rotation we did last week and a short memo describing the approval flow + who invoked emergency access. they want correlation between SIEM, KMS audit, and deploy logs.

tom: I can pull rotation events and key versions. Which KMS? cloud-kms prod key `redwood-svc-encrypt-prod`?

nina: yes. provide versions list + vault audit entries. filter time window 2026-03-10T02:00Z..2026-03-10T05:00Z. auditor also wants the runbook step that was followed.

clare: include the emergency access ticket id and the Slack approval thread link. we used escalation policy EP-3.

tom: grabbing: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-svc-encrypt-prod --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --sort-by=~createTime` and `gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloudkms_keyring AND protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UpdateCryptoKeyVersion"" --start-time=2026-03-10T02:00:00Z --end-time=2026-03-10T05:00:00Z`

sec-bot: compliance-hint: provide SHA256 hashes of exported artifacts, redact PII, and include chain-of-custody.md. retention note: 7 years.

ops-bob: I've exported the KMS audit slice and rotated-key metadata. Also pulled SIEM alert ID SIEM-7789 and the runbook that triggered manual rotate step 4b.

nina: good. auditor may ask if the rotation was full key material destroy+recreate or key version rotation. This was version rotation (new version created, old versions scheduled for destroy). note that we documented ephemeral-decryption-window = 15m in the README.

clare: auditor asked specifically: who assumed emergency access role? provide principal and justification log.

tom: emergency access assumed by `svc-ops-priv` via `assume-role` flow. I included AWS STS assume role logs: `aws sts get-session-token` entries and session tags.

ops-bob: also linking vuln triage doc: SEC-4388 (root cause: certificate expiry caused automated rotation to fail -> manual intervention). mitigation: cert renewed, autoscaling job fixed. Triage notes summarised in SEC-4388-Triage.md in the bundle.

clare: prepare a short narrative paragraph (2-3 lines) describing timeline + decision rationale for the auditor. keep it factual.

nina: draft: "On 2026-03-10 at ~02:34Z automated key rotation failed due to certificate expiry, triggering pager and SIEM-7789. On-call invoked escalation EP-3, manual key-version rotation was performed under emergency access by principal svc-ops-priv after documented approval by Security Lead (Clare). Artifacts provided: KMS audit slice, SIEM alert, CI/CD deployment id, emergency ticket SEC-4388, and runbook excerpt showing the approved step sequence."

clare: perfect. strip any internal tickets that contain customer data and replace with placeholders before sharing. auditor needs hashed artifacts.

tom: creating a ZIP with: kms-audit.log, siem-siem-7789.json, assume-role.log, ci-deploy-ci-20260310-1123.json, SEC-4388-triage.txt, README-chainofcustody.md. computing sha256s.

sec-bot: artifact-check: all files present, README includes who exported (tom), export method, UTC export timestamp 2026-03-12T16:12:00Z, and hash list.

ops-bob: upload done. s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/kpmg-mar-2026/emergency-rotate-1769880001.zip

clare: DM auditor link and paste a short note with CI run id: ci-20260310-1123 and the Slack approval message permalink.

auditor-mike: received, thanks. quick follow-up: can you show the exact commands used to perform the rotate (sanitized)? we want to confirm no manual private key export occurred.

tom: shared sanitized command snippet in README: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-svc-encrypt-prod --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --protection-level=software` plus commands used to schedule old versions for destruction. no `cryptoKeyMaterialExport` calls present.

auditor-mike: good. last Q: any post-rotate verification outputs? e.g., sample envelope decrypt check or staging smoke test result?

nina: yes, smoke test passed at 02:48Z (log included: smoke-tests/rotate-check-02-48.log).

auditor-mike: that's everything for now. appreciate the quick turnaround.

clare: closing loop. I'll update control mapping doc with this sample under CC7 and linkSEC-4388.
